package.name: kalman_fusion_sim
package.description: Gazebo (gz sim, Harmonic/Ionic) simulation for the kalman_fusion node: a simple differential-drive robot carrying an IMU and a pose/odometry sensor, bridged to ROS2 via ros_gz_bridge so its data flows into the fusion node. Ships a pure-Python, ROS-free mock sensor source (MockSensorSource) plus a thin driver node so the whole sim -> fusion pipeline is demonstrable and CI-testable WITHOUT Gazebo installed.
